notes.title: Hope River Town Update is Live! 🌵
notes.notes:
[p]Howdy folks,[/p][p]We know you’ve been waiting a long time for this, and today we’re thrilled to finally bring you the [b]biggest content update yet[/b] for [i]Dust & Courage: Jake Bolton’s Journey[/i]![/p][p]This update has taken longer than expected, mainly because we wanted to implement proper gamepad support first (a highly requested feature). It delayed things by over a month, but we believe it was worth the wait, and now the new content is finally ready for you to discover.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="fTbnZpXnBNQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]What’s New in This Update?[/h3][p][/p][p]We’ve added [b]over 1 hour of fresh gameplay content[/b], bringing the total playtime of the Early Access version up to [b]around 3 hours[/b]. Here’s what you’ll find in this update:[/p][list][*][p][b]A New Town: Hope River Town[/b][/p][p] If you remember Hope River from the demo, forget what you saw back then. [b]We’ve overhauled almost everything.[/b] The only thing that remains the same is its name. The new Hope River Town is richer, deeper, and full of new stories waiting to be discovered.[/p][/*][*][p][b]14 New NPCs to Meet[/b] [/p][p] Each with unique personalities and dialogue.[/p][/*][*][p][b]10+ New Quests[/b] [/p][p] Expanding Jake’s journey with brand new challenges and decisions to make.[/p][/*][*][p][b]5 New Weapons[/b] [/p][p] Fresh ways to fight your battles, both up close and at range.[/p][/*][*][p][b]10 New Outfits[/b] [/p][p]Customize Jake’s look and style to your liking.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Why the Delay?[/h3][p]As mentioned, this update was pushed back because we wanted to make sure accessibility features such as [b]gamepad support, WASD movement, and auto-attack[/b] were fully functional before releasing new content. Many of you have requested it, and we understand the importance it holds for immersion and accessibility. We appreciate your patience, it’s finally here, and we hope it makes your experience even smoother.[/p][p][/p][h3]What’s Next?[/h3][p]We’re getting closer to the end of Jake’s story. Most of the Early Access content is now in place, and you’re already seeing more than half of the full game.[/p][p]From here on out, our main focus will be on finishing the story. If everything goes according to plan, we hope to wrap up development in the next [b]4–6 months[/b]. Of course, game development is unpredictable, so no promises, but that’s the goal.[/p][p]At the same time, half of our team has already started working on our second project. It’s still too early to share much, but if you want to catch the first details when the time comes, make sure to follow us on our social media channels. 
[url=https://discord.gg/vtdtWscChE] 
 
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44980757/b9e06642e24be956be4eb56134628a5e52ad2f91.png[/img][/url][h3]Thank You[/h3][p]Your feedback and support mean the world to us. This project is being built with your input at every step, and we couldn’t do it without you. Please keep sharing your thoughts on our [b]Steam Discussion; [/b]we read every single one.[/p][p]So saddle up, head into [b]Hope River Town[/b], and let us know what you think![/p][p]See you on the dusty trail,
The Storyforge Team
[/p]

notes.title: Auto Attack and WASD Movement Update!
notes.notes:
Since we released the very first demo of Dust&Courage: Jake Bolton's Journey, we’ve heard three big, recurring requests from you:

[list]
[*] WASD movement
[*] Auto-attack
[*] And of course, gamepad support
[/list]

We’ve been all ears from day one and doing our best to bring these features to life alongside you. After a bit of gentle pressure (and maybe annoying our dev just enough times), one day he finally snapped, in the best way possible. He paused everything and went off to build a whole new system.

The result? You can now move with WASD and enable auto-attack, no more relying solely on the mouse!

To try these new features out, just update to the latest version of the game and head over to the Settings menu. We’ve made sure you can toggle them on or off however you like, so if you prefer the old-school controls, that’s totally cool too.

Now, let’s talk gamepad support.

This one means a lot, not just to you, but to us as well. We’ve always known how important it is for everyone to be able to play the game comfortably, and folks using a Steam Deck. But truth be told, making this happen earlier would’ve pushed our full release back by at least two months.

So… we asked our dev again. And again. And again. We may have been banned from Discord a few times in the process. But then one day, something changed. A message struck a chord, and just like that, he rolled up his sleeves and got to work on full gamepad support.

Yes, really. The “impossible” feature is now in development!

While we’re moving fast, we can’t give an exact release date just yet. But rest assured, it’s coming very soon.

If you’ve read this far… hey there!
Hope you’re having a great week. Thanks so much for all your support, feedback, and patience. We’re beyond grateful ❤️

With love,
The Storyforge Team

notes.title: Major Update: We’ve Redesigned Our Characters!
notes.notes:
Howdy, cowboys!

We are thrilled to bring you our very first devlog, packed with exciting news. Dust&Courage: Jake Bolton's Journey is our first indie game, and it holds a special place in our hearts. Bringing this project to life has been like experiencing the excitement of a new adventure. As a small team of four, we had no idea how massive this project would become, but now we’re on the verge of completing our first demo.

What started as a mere dream has transformed into a fully-fledged game studio, and here we stand, a team of four long-time friends, united by a shared passion. Our 20-year friendship has significantly influenced this project, with some of us even leaving our professional careers to pursue game development full-time. We aim to channel this excitement into creating the best experience for you.

Since our prototype, there have been numerous improvements we've aimed to make. Our primary goal has always been to tell a compelling story. We consider ourselves storytellers first and game developers second, and we want to reflect that in our games. Although we have finished writing the story for our game, there are still many aspects we want to enhance. We started with visual changes. Since launching our Steam page, we’ve updated our character designs to offer you a more unique gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980757/20eeb256f1559877231db4351ca09353d7e413b8.gif[/img]

In addition to updating our main character, Jake, we have almost completely redesigned our game world. We’ve revamped nearly every area from scratch, and we can’t wait to show them to you. Alongside these changes, we’ve also updated the visuals, text, and layout of our Steam page. We hope you’ll enjoy the new look.

Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us, so please don’t hesitate to share your thoughts. You can reach us through the Steam discussion section or join our Discord channel. Our development team is eager to answer your questions and chat with you.

[url=https://discord.gg/vtdtWscChE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980757/b9e06642e24be956be4eb56134628a5e52ad2f91.png[/img][/url]

With love,
The Storyforge Team
